why: xPST is a named software authoring system and tutor engine for building embedded tutors over third-party applications, not a general theory of learning.
name: xPST
product_description: xPST is an authoring system and tutor engine developed by Stephen B. Gilbert and colleagues that lets instructional designers create embedded, model-tracing-like tutors for third-party software through TutorLink plug-ins and instruction files.
